result.summary: Found a few visual issues, mainly overlapping restaurant metadata and content being obscured by fixed navigation.

issues.description: The metadata line under “Tokumaru Ramen Bar” is visually broken: the delivery time and delivery fee text overlap, making the line hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the layout spacing for the restaurant metadata row. Ensure each metadata item has enough horizontal space, uses proper separators, and wraps or truncates cleanly if needed.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar overlaps the restaurant list content. The second restaurant card image is partially hidden behind the fixed bottom tab bar.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding or safe-area inset to the scrollable content so cards can scroll fully above the bottom navigation.

issues.description: Some horizontally scrolling items on the right edge are cut off, including the category chip row and the “Fastest near you” restaurant cards. This may be intentional carousel behavior, but it looks slightly abrupt.
issues.suggestion: If intentional, consider adding a fade/peek treatment or consistent side padding. If not intentional, constrain the carousel content so items are not clipped unexpectedly.
